newsitem.title: USA: David White Inc posts Q4 net on sales expansion.
newsitem.headline: David White Inc posts Q4 net on sales expansion.

text.p: David White Inc said Thursday an expansion of sales of its optical and laser surveying equipment to mass merchandisers helped the company post a profit in the fourth quarter ended December 31.

The company reported net income of $93,000, or $0.21 a share, in the period. Losses a year ago reached $745,000 after a one-time charge related to the termination of a pension plan and an environmental compliance issue, the company said.
David White posted revenues of $3.1 million in the latest quarter, up from $3.0 million in 1995.
The company said it is optimistic about prospects in 1997 thanks in part to an increasing volume of product orders.
